description: LUME sealed sender, CRYPTO.md sections 7.3 and 8, computed with Node.js crypto (OpenSSL) and a JavaScript HChaCha20 checked against every Wycheproof XChaCha20-Poly1305 case; the seal key is the one of case 0 of handshake.json, signed by its Bob; each envelope draws the ephemeral secret (32 bytes) and then the nonce (24 bytes) from SHA-256(random_seed || u64 counter); a refusal must be refused with the error it names, and the generator has checked that skipping the check it names would change the outcome

cases.name: first_message
cases.description: Alice's first message: the initial header of case 0 of handshake.json and step A0 of ratchet.json

cases.name: later_message
cases.description: a message without an initial header: step A3 of ratchet.json

cases.name: full_bucket
cases.description: a 4095-byte inner, so the marker is the last byte of the 4096 bucket; its 3978-byte body comes from SHA-256("LUME seal vector body" || u64 counter)

refusals.name: wrong_key_id
refusals.description: sealed correctly, but under seal key id + 1

refusals.name: ephemeral_key_with_top_bit
refusals.description: a valid ephemeral key with bit 255 set, sealed consistently with those bytes; X25519 ignores the bit, so only the canonical check refuses it

refusals.name: unreduced_ephemeral_key
refusals.description: the ephemeral key is p + 9, the base point left unreduced, sealed consistently; the shared secret is then the seal key's own public key, so only the canonical check refuses it

refusals.name: low_order_ephemeral_key
refusals.description: the ephemeral key is 0, sealed with the all-zero shared secret it gives, so only the low-order check refuses it

refusals.name: forged_box
refusals.description: the last byte of the box, part of the tag, is changed

refusals.name: padding_in_a_larger_bucket
refusals.description: the inner fits the 2048 bucket but is padded to 4096

refusals.name: padding_without_marker
refusals.description: the inner is followed only by zero bytes

refusals.name: byte_after_the_marker
refusals.description: the last byte of the padding is 0x01

refusals.name: empty_plaintext
refusals.description: the box authenticates an empty plaintext

refusals.name: inner_with_a_trailing_byte
refusals.description: correctly padded, but the inner has one byte after its last field

refusals.name: sender_is_not_the_initiator
refusals.description: the sender hint differs from ik_sig of the initial header in one bit
